name: hospitable
description: Connect Hospitable to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Hospitable MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Hospitable to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with short-term rental operations using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Hospitable workspace.
Find anything in Hospitable that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review short-term rental operations in Hospitable.
